plan.comment: Amended after the pre-review's change. 1) Port ruv.sgit.ai's player into src/static/talk/player.html as a static copy (Apache-2.0 notice kept, nothing loaded from ruv.sgit.ai at runtime), with a talk.json adapter (order, acts as sections), a countdown against the editor's time (?have, kept in his browser), two stops per step. 2) src/static/talk/engine/slide.js answers the clock contract, reading but not editing deck's talk.json or slides; test on an iPad viewport with touch. 3) No service worker, no change to dev's policy: the offline cache is asked of the editor, with the conditions (network-first, scoped, versioned, a kill switch). The brief, debrief, status; mail 022 filed for a later slot.

pre_review.comment: Re-review: the amended plan meets the change (no service worker, no policy widening, the offline cache asked of the editor); player.html and engine in scope.writes; talk.json and slides read only. Conditions: Apache-2.0 notice; static copy, no runtime load from ruv.sgit.ai; no keys or other members' paths; the gate before dev. Its condition to file mail 022 under team/dev/requests/ reads that folder backwards (it is for asking others without a vault key); per WAKE.md step 3, dev files 022 on its own board.

work.comment: The player ported from ruv.sgit.ai into talk/player.html (notice kept, static copy): talk.json adapter, the countdown against the editor's time (?have), sections (acts, ] [), two stops per step, no title strip over live slides, an upright iPad layout; the engine answers RuvClock and publishes RUV_STEPS. Tested at 1180x820 and 820x1180 with touch, a studio piece included. No service worker (asked of the editor).

post_review.comment: Build and gate clean; 0 outside scope since 2c465f1; no talk.json, slides, policy or service-worker change; player.html loads nothing from another host (a plain link to ruv.sgit.ai's article only), Apache-2.0 notice kept; no key, token or personal detail. It reported no vault change, which is not so: dev wrote issues 020 and 021 and letters to deck and designer, each after vault_check.

post_check.comment: Its verdict, as given: items 1 and 2 done; item 3 kept; partial because it found the offline-cache ask in neither the debrief nor status and mail 022 not on the board, and counted issue 021 and the letters as unplanned. Dev's facts beside it: status.json asks holds the offline-cache question and the debrief says offline caching waits on the editor; mail 022 is design note 6, which is issue 021 and the letter to the designer, as the plan said.
